claims.claim: Exact peak-tail KL and concentration decompositions for positive finite categorical distributions; all 10400 actual prefix mixtures, 62400 dyadic rows, 41600 one-draw moments checked. Tail KL >1e-9 in 7680 prefixes, mean tail fraction .406062 among KL>1e-12, max matched-peak TV .755110. X Binder undefined86 retained.
claims.limit: Peak-matched diagnostic, not independent prediction of M; no physical order parameter or interaction identification.

claims.claim: Noninteracting one-spike categorical law has exact shifted sigmoid collapse, finite score Fisher peak and centered Bernoulli U4=2/3 at half mass. 96 development-only fits, 4536 grid candidates, 48 L21 external comparisons; critical-width beats all three alternatives 12/48, h64 3/16, one paired pointwise improvement against development-selected noncritical model. No universal exponent or impossibility claim.
claims.limit: Existing independent cohorts previously studied; finite score-control design, no calibrated transition or multiplicity-adjusted inference.
